determinism: Sorted members; mode0644; uid/gid/mtime zero; empty user/group/gzip filename; gzip mtime zero. Same frozen inputs and compression toolchain produce identical tar.gz and manifest.
excluded: Unspecified paths, symlinks/hardlinks, wrappers, executable/binary/PDF payloads, states, environment dumps, imported descriptions, and prior archives.
scope: Exact reviewed text evidence only. Packaging does not certify test success or alter diagnostic classifications.
screening: Known Symbolica/license/token/key/Bearer formats and sensitive assignments reject the package without printing matches. This heuristic is not proof that every possible secret is absent.
self_reference: MANIFEST.json describes payloads only; adjacent package-receipt.json hashes archive and manifest.
